default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-848.title: Lunch-box break follow
E-848.hypothesis: The thin 12:00-13:00 box coils resting orders; the first close beyond it after 13:00 (until 14:30) releases stops and follows with the returning liquidity.

E-849.title: Bar-colour breadth fade
E-849.hypothesis: When nearly all recent bars share one colour, the move is crowded and one-sided; the first threshold cross is a stretched sample and tends to revert.

E-850.title: Open-price recross after a drive
E-850.hypothesis: After the day pushed away from its open by more than usual, a close back through the open price shows the drive's buyers or sellers are trapped; follow the recross.

E-851.title: Index and dollar moving the same way
E-851.hypothesis: WIN and WDO usually move inversely; a large same-direction move in both is a risk-off/on anomaly or liquidity squeeze in one leg, and tends to snap back.

E-852.title: Heavy-day breakout on the VWAP side
E-852.hypothesis: On a session whose cumulative volume runs above its usual pace, a new range extreme on the VWAP side comes with participation and continues.

E-853.title: Bar-open jump fill
E-853.hypothesis: An unusual jump between one close and the next open is noise from thin books; a bar that trades back against the jump is a gap fill in progress.

E-854.title: Range-position swing follow
E-854.hypothesis: A close that travels from the bottom (top) edge of the session range through its midpoint shows control changing sides; follow the crossing.

E-856.title: Drift-excess follow
E-856.hypothesis: Return from the open in excess of the usual path for this time of day, measured against typical size, marks flow beyond the habitual drift; follow it.

E-857.title: VWAP and prior-close confluence cross
E-857.hypothesis: Price clearing both the session VWAP and yesterday's close puts day-traders and swing holders on the same side; follow the first close past both.
